mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_store_capacity_guard(store_id,version,updated_at) VALUES(#{storeId},0,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE store_id=store_id
mapper.select: SELECT store_id FROM schedule_store_capacity_guard WHERE store_id=#{storeId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM schedule_reservation WHERE order_id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_id,store_id,status,version,lock_expire_at FROM schedule_reservation WHERE id=#{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_reservation SET status='RELEASED',version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{reservationId} AND version=#{version} AND status='CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_reservation_audit WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND action='REFUND_RELEASE' AND request_id=#{requestId} AND actor_type='SYSTEM'
SELECT window_id FROM schedule_reservation_claim WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,merchant_id,store_id,service_id,window_kind,start_at,end_at, configured_capacity,status,version FROM schedule_availability_window FORCE INDEX (idx_schedule_service_time) WHERE store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,order_id,user_id,merchant_id,store_id,service_id,fulfillment_type, start_at,end_at,pickup_start_at,return_start_at,status,version FROM schedule_reservation FORCE INDEX (idx_reservation_service_time) WHERE store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id,c.reservation_id,c.window_id,c.store_id,c.service_id,c.kind, c.start_at,c.end_at FROM schedule_reservation_claim c FORCE INDEX (idx_claim_store_reservation) WHERE c.store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY c.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id FROM schedule_reservation r FORCE INDEX (idx_reservation_service_time) JOIN schedule_reservation_claim c FORCE INDEX (uk_claim_reservation_kind) ON c.reservation_id=r.id WHERE r.store_id=#{storeId} AND c.store_id<>#{storeId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id,store_id,staff_id,start_at,end_at,status,version FROM staff_availability_window FORCE INDEX (idx_store_avail_time) WHERE store_id=#{storeId} ORDER BY staff_id,start_at,id FOR UPDATE
